title: Review: crypto2dev-shim CryptoCb port
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Two P0 correctness bugs (EOPNOTSUPP not promoted to fallback; assign_devid rollback corrupts state), plus one ambiguous FIPS probe design (P1). These will generate user reports. The HMAC buffer growth is a latent OOM risk for any non-TLS HMAC usage. Core architecture is sound.
Confidence: 25% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl semantics are unknown without the kernel driver — may be a query or may be a fd-level mode switch; (2) wolfSSL's behavior when a devId is set but unregistered (silent software fallback vs error) is not verified; (3) no review of configure.ac, include.am, or CI script changes; (4) no dynamic testing — all findings are static. Would raise confidence if: kernel driver source for CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS is reviewed; and the test suite is run against the simulator.
